# Night-build branch: test/start-minimized-on-installed
# Applied oldest first, on top of the upstream release tag (not master).
# A conflict stops the run. Nothing is pushed, and the build branch stays where it is.
# The tip of each branch is what gets applied.
#
# Merge when the branch point on upstream master is already in the release.
# Otherwise cherry-pick only the commits that are not in upstream master,
# so a branch cut from later master does not drag unreleased upstream history in.
#
# Not applied, on purpose:
# - feat/rest-api-port-flag: the same --rest-api-port change, retargeted at
#   upstream master for PR 11432.
# - feat/gcal-hide-time-block-titles: the calendar title setting, upstream PR 11438.
#   It replaces the hardcoded "Focus time" commit, which is still what the
#   installed build runs.
# - feat/gcal-private-time-blocks-option: abandoned.
# - The Wayland idle helper is a pinned binary the night build copies in.
#   It is not a git branch. The source is already upstream.

port/rest-api-v19.2
feat/rest-api-port
feat/gcal-private-time-blocks
feat/start-minimized
